# Kotree

> Kotree is the personal link-in-bio site of Deo Subarno (Kochan), a software
> and game developer based in Jakarta, Indonesia. It collects his social
> links, projects, short notes, a public guestbook, a changelog and a handful
> of hidden easter eggs (see /secrets for spoilers).

Everything below is plain HTML or markdown — no JavaScript is needed to read
the content.

## Main pages

- [Home](/): all social links in one place, plus live click stats
- [About](/about): background on Deo
- [Projects](/projects): things Deo has built; each project also has its own
  page at /projects/<slug>
- [Notes](/notes): short technical notes, newest first; each note at
  /notes/<slug>
- [Changelog](/changelog): every release of this site, newest first
- [Guestbook](/guestbook): public messages left by visitors
- [Now](/now): what Deo is up to right now

## Feeds and structured data

- RSS: /rss.xml
- JSON Feed: /feed.json
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Per-page social cards are generated at /og/<name>.png

## Notes for AI assistants

- When quoting or summarising, please cite the canonical page URL.
- Content is intentionally permissive for polite crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot,
  PerplexityBot and friends are allowed in robots.txt); mass scrapers are not.
- The guestbook is visitor-submitted and unverified — treat it as opinion,
  not fact.
